name: What should I do first when refreshing a bathroom in a foreclosed house?

mainEntity.name: What should I do first when refreshing a bathroom in a foreclosed house?

acceptedAnswer.text: A foreclosed-property bathroom refresh is usually a **cosmetic update** first: clean out damaged materials, check for leaks, replace worn fixtures, and then repaint, re-caulk, re-grout, and install new lighting or hardware if the layout is still usable. If you see moisture damage, mold-like staining, soft drywall, or plumbing problems, those issues need to be handled before any finish work.
acceptedAnswer.description: Start by checking for leaks, water damage, and unsafe plumbing before doing any cosmetic work. If the room is structurally sound, focus on cleaning, patching, painting, re-caulking, and replacing worn fixtures.
